arxiv-1910-09327.title: POTL: A First-Order Complete Temporal Logic for Operator Precedence Languages
arxiv-1910-09327.creator: Michele Chiari, Dino Mandrioli, Matteo Pradella
arxiv-1910-09327.description: Abstract . The problem of model checking procedural programs has fostered much research towards the definition of temporal logics for reasoning on context-free structures. The most notable of such results are temporal logics on Nested Words, such as CaRet and NWTL.

arxiv-2308-07552.title: Resilience assessment and planning in power distribution systems: Past and future considerations
arxiv-2308-07552.creator: Paul, S, Poudyal, A, Poudel, S, Dubey, A, Wang, Z
arxiv-2308-07552.description: Abstract Over the past decade, extreme weather events have significantly increased worldwide, leading to widespread power outages and blackouts. As these threats continue to challenge power distribution systems, the importance of mitigating the impacts of extreme weather events has become paramount. Consequently, resilience has become crucial for designing and operating power distribution systems.

arxiv-2308-10570.title: Self-Feedback DETR for Temporal Action Detection
arxiv-2308-10570.creator: Jihwan Kim, Miso Lee, Jae-Pil Heo
arxiv-2308-10570.description: Abstract Temporal Action Detection (TAD) is challenging but fundamental for real-world video applications. Recently, DETR-based models have been devised for TAD but have not performed well yet. In this paper, we point out the problem in the self-attention of DETR for TAD; the attention modules focus on a few key elements, called temporal collapse problem.

arxiv-2312-00646.title: Distributed Asynchronous Discrete-Time Feedback Optimization
arxiv-2312-00646.creator: Gabriel Behrendt, Matthew Longmire, Zachary I. Bell, Matthew Hale
arxiv-2312-00646.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Gabriel Behrendt, Matthew Longmire, Zachary I. Bell, Matthew Hale. In this article, we present an algorithm that drives the outputs of a network of agents to jointly track the solutions of time-varying optimization problems in a way that is robust to asynchrony in the agents’ operations. We consider three operations that can be asynchronous: (1) computations of control inputs, (2) measurements of network outputs, and (3) communications of agents’ inputs and outputs.

arxiv-2312-07720.title: Molecular sieve vacuum swing adsorption purification and radon reduction system for gaseous dark matter and rare-event detectors
arxiv-2312-07720.creator: and H. Ogawa
arxiv-2312-07720.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by and H. Ogawa. In the field of directional dark matter experiments SF 6 \text{SF}{\vphantom{\text{X}}}_{\vphantom{\text{2}}\smash[t]{\text{6}}}^{\vphantom{\smash[t]{\text{2}}}\hphantom{\text{6}}\text{}} has emerged as an ideal target gas. A critical challenge with this gas, and with other proposed gases, is the effective removal of contaminant gases. This includes radon which produce unwanted background events, but also common pollutants such as water, oxygen and nitrogen, which can capture ionisation electrons, resulting in loss of detector gas gain over time.

arxiv-2412-04186.title: Modification on thermal motion in Geant4 for neutron capture simulation in Gadolinium loaded water
arxiv-2412-04186.creator: Y. Hino, K. Abe, R. Asaka, S. Han, M. Harada, M. Ishitsuka, H. Ito, S. Izumiyama, Y. Kanemura, Y. Koshio, F. Nakanishi, H. Sekiya, T. Yano
arxiv-2412-04186.description: Abstract Neutron tagging is a fundamental technique for electron anti-neutrino detection via the inverse beta decay channel. A reported discrepancy in neutron detection efficiency between observational data and simulation predictions prompted an investigation into neutron capture modeling in Geant4. The study revealed that an overestimation of the thermal motion of hydrogen atoms in Geant4 impacts the fraction of captured nuclei.

arxiv-2502-00395.title: FlexCloud: Direct, Modular Georeferencing and Drift-Correction of Point Cloud Maps
arxiv-2502-00395.creator: Maximilian Leitenstern 1 , Marko Alten 1 , Christian Bolea-Schaser 1 , Dominik Kulmer 1 , Marcel Weinmann 1 , and Markus Lienkamp 1 1 Institute of Automotive Technology, Technical University of Munich, Boltzmannstraße 15, 85748 Garching, Germany maxi.leitenstern@tum.de
arxiv-2502-00395.description: Abstract Current software stacks for real-world applications of autonomous driving leverage map information to ensure reliable localization, path planning, and motion prediction. An important field of research is the generation of point cloud maps, referring to the topic of simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM).

arxiv-2503-20914.title: D4R - Exploring and Querying Relational Graphs Using Natural Language and Large Language Models - the Case of Historical Documents
arxiv-2503-20914.creator: Michel Boeglin, David Kahn, Josiane Mothe, Diego Ortiz, David Panzoli
arxiv-2503-20914.description: Abstract D4R is a digital platform designed to assist non-technical users, particularly historians, in exploring textual documents through advanced graphical tools for text analysis and knowledge extraction. By leveraging a large language model, D4R translates natural language questions into Cypher queries, enabling the retrieval of data from a Neo4J database.

arxiv-2602-21379.title: MrBERT: Modern Multilingual Encoders via Vocabulary, Domain, and Dimensional Adaptation
arxiv-2602-21379.creator: Daniel Tamayo ∗1, Iñaki Lacunza ∗1, Paula Rivera-Hidalgo ∗1, Severino Da Dalt 1, Javier Aula-Blasco 1, Aitor Gonzalez-Agirre 1, Marta Villegas 1
arxiv-2602-21379.description: Abstract We introduce MrBERT, a family of 150M-300M parameter encoders built on the ModernBERT architecture and pre-trained on 35 languages and code. Through targeted adaptation, this model family achieves state-of-the-art results on Catalan- and Spanish-specific tasks, while establishing robust performance across specialized biomedical and legal domains.

dio-cassius-roman-history-cary-vol-8.creator: Dio Cassius (Earnest Cary, trans.)
dio-cassius-roman-history-cary-vol-8.description: Dio Cassius's Roman History (c. 230 CE), Books 61-70: Nero through the Flavians and Trajan, in the Byzantine epitome of Xiphilinus, in Earnest Cary's 1914-1927 Loeb translation via Internet Archive (English text only). pmc-10628086.description: Background and Objectives:Acinetobacter baumannii, an opportunistic pathogen, is related to hospital-acquired infections and increased mortality. This study aimed to develop the loop-mediated isothermal amplification (LAMP) test for the fast-detecting of A. baumannii isolates as well as determining genetic relatedness for these isolates via the REP-PCR technique.Materials and Methods:LAMP primers and multiplex PCR primers were designed for recognizing A.

pmc-11492754.title: Comparison of genotypic features between two groups of antibiotic resistant Klebsiella pneumoniae clinical isolates obtained before and after the COVID-19 pandemic from Egypt
pmc-11492754.creator: Pansee Gamaleldin, Mustafa Alseqely, Benjamin A. Evans, Hoda Omar, Alaa Abouelfetouh
pmc-11492754.description: Klebsiella pneumoniae is a common pathogen capable of causing a wide range of infections. Antibiotic resistance complicates treatment of these infections significantly. We are comparing resistance levels and genotypes among two collections of K. pneumoniae clinical isolates from Alexandria Main University Hospital (AMUH).

pmc-11546150.title: Molecular tool for efficient breeding of DOMINANT Greenshell laying hens and significant refinement of phenotypic selection focused on eggshell color
pmc-11546150.creator: Kristina Beranova, Eva Jozova, Vojtech Anderle, Michael Rost, Lukas Zita, Pavel Beran, Helena Tyllerova Landova, Vladislav Curn, Milan Tyller
pmc-11546150.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). In recent decades, interest in non-traditionally colored eggs has increased. For breeders, this market interest means breeding lines of laying hens that lay eggs of varied colors, such as the blue-green eggshells (Dominant Greenshell) in this study. This study presents the results of genotyping the polymorphism of the O locus responsible for shell coloration and photometric measurement of eggshell color based on the CIELAb system, which was carried out on the unique Czech breeding population Dominant Greenshell.

pmc-12546881.title: Tourniquet application during ipsilateral shoulder surgery in a hemodialysis patient - A case report of proximal tourniquet technique (proximal tourniquet technique in a hemodialysis patient during shoulder surgery)
pmc-12546881.creator: Dong Ju Shin, Jae Hwi Han
pmc-12546881.description: Introduction and importanceSurgical management of fractures in hemodialysis patients presents challenges due to altered bone metabolism, bleeding tendencies, and vascular access issues. The presence of an arteriovenous fistula (AVF) further complicates hemostasis, especially in upper extremity surgeries with extensive soft tissue dissection.

pmc-12807971.title: Integrative proteomics and metabolomics analysis of the mechanism of pancreatic β-cell dysfunction in aged mice
pmc-12807971.creator: Fenghui Pan, Long Wang, Xuan He, Can Rong, Yun Hu
pmc-12807971.description: ObjectivesThe prevalence of type 2 diabetes mellitus has increased worldwide and is higher among older individuals. Exploring the mechanisms underlying pancreatic β-cell dysfunction may help elucidate the pathogenesis of age-related diabetes.MethodsIslet function-related parameters were measured in four young and four aged mice.

pmc-13519152.title: The Cost of Inpatient Scabies Treatment in the Philippines: Secondary Data Analysis from the Philippine Health Insurance Corporation Database
pmc-13519152.creator: Rowena F. Genuino, Emilio Q. Villanueva
pmc-13519152.description: BackgroundWhile outpatient management for classic scabies is the standard, severe cases, such as infected scabies or crusted scabies in immunocompromised individuals, may require inpatient care, increasing the financial burden on healthcare systems.ObjectiveThis retrospective study of the cost of scabies inpatient cases from the Philippine Health Insurance Corporation (PhilHealth) database was undertaken to provide valuable insights for policy-making and resource allocation.

pmc-13663170.title: Habitat-based imaging and peritumoral radiomics on ultrasound images for predicting lymphovascular invasion in breast invasive ductal carcinoma: a two-center study
pmc-13663170.creator: Taixia Liu, Guojia Zhao, Wei Wei, Qingling Zhang, Jing Wu, Xuying Chen, Dong Liu, Xiangming Zhu
pmc-13663170.description: PurposeThis study aimed to evaluate the feasibility of employing habitat-based radiomic distributions in ultrasound (US) images to quantitatively characterize intratumoral heterogeneity. It also explored the potential of this approach to predict lymphovascular invasion (LVI) in breast invasive ductal carcinoma (IDC) patients and to identify the optimal extent of multiple peritumoral regions.
